ThingDef.label: comb ice-rock
ThingDef.description: Water-ice bedrock, pale and squared by something that was not weather. It is one tine of a horseshoe wider than a village, and the horseshoe is only the part of a larger thing that stands above the floor.

ThingDef.label: black busbar
ThingDef.description: A slab of black conductor cut straight through the ice and out of sight in both directions. It hums at the edge of hearing. Where it leaves the horseshoe it runs on beneath the floor, past the edge of the map, toward machinery nobody here has seen the end of.

ThingDef.label: inspection stud
ThingDef.description: A capped test stud set into the inner rim of the junction, where an engineer once clipped a meter to read the current going home. Overhead, the drowned aurora makes its glass cap flicker in no pattern a person has worked out. This is the return junction of the planet's unfinished dynamo; nobody here controls it, and nothing here answers back.
